report.thanks_body: The masjid now has what it needs to look into it. If it is urgent, ring the office on 01204 535 997.
report.placeholder: e.g. the live stream would not play, or a screen stayed blank
report.failed: That didn’t send — check your connection and try again, or ring the office on 01204 535 997.
report.privacy: This sends your app version, your phone model, and a short log of the last few screens — so the masjid can see what happened. It does not send your name, your number, or anything you typed into a form.
events.offline: Events will appear once you’re back online. Pull down to try again.
events.will_appear: When the masjid puts something on, the poster and the date will be here.
help.report_intro: If something would not load, or did not work the way it should, tell the masjid here. It sends a short record of what the app was doing — which is usually what makes a problem fixable.
nikah.the_office_will_confirm: The office will confirm the time when it replies.
member.email_looks_wrong: That does not look like an email address. Please check it.
member.cannot_reach: The masjid could not be reached just now. Please try again in a moment, or ring the office on {office}.
member.code_sent_neutral: If {email} is on the register, a six-digit code is on its way. It lasts ten minutes.
member.code_six_digits: The code is six digits. Please type all six.
member.code_locked: Too many tries on that code. Please wait a few minutes, then send a new one.
member.code_expired: That code has expired. Please send a new one.
member.code_didnt_work: That code did not work. Check it and try again, or send a new one.
member.no_membership_for_email: We could not find a membership against that email. The office can link it to your record — {office}, 5pm to 7pm.
member.email_intro: We will send a six-digit code to the email the masjid holds for you. Only someone who can open that inbox can see the record — which is what keeps it private.
member.no_email_on_file: No email on your record? The office can add one, or check your membership for you — ring 01204 535 997, 5pm to 7pm.
member.which_member_intro: This email is on more than one membership. Choose yours — these are the records that share your inbox.
member.your_record_only: Your own record, kept private — opened with your email.
member.collected_in_ramadan: Collected in Ramadan, as it always has been. The year is named by the calendar year it covers.
member.sign_in_with_email: Sign in with the email the masjid holds
member.at_the_masjid_v: Cash or card at the office during Ramadan.
member.by_transfer_v: Ask the office for the details and quote your reference.
member.charity_line: Bolton Central Islamic Society · Registered charity 1041569
member.paid_this_year_sub: Jazāk Allāhu khayran — there is nothing to pay for this year.
member.not_on_record_year: We don’t have your {year} membership on record yet.
member.to_pay_see_office_p: To pay your {year} membership, speak to the office — {office}, 5pm to 7pm. Once it is recorded, this screen will show your membership as paid.
